longs.title: GTA 6 Free Roam - Cops, Crashes and Getting Busted
longs.description: Free roam in GTA 6 on my live stream: Jason's morning, the huge map, a first wanted level, looting a police car, stealing trucks, the bridge drive, a police chase on foot and a quad bike escape that ends in busted.

segments.label: Police Car Loot and a Crash

longs.title: GTA 6 Joey's Garage and Brian's Rent - Full Gameplay
longs.description: Driving to Joey's garage at sunset, fixing up and repainting Lucia's car, a night drive and collecting Brian's rent.

longs.title: GTA 6 Stealing the Phoenix From the Police Impound - Full Mission
longs.description: Jason and Cal drive through the morning fog to the police impound, Jason sneaks in, steals the Phoenix, hides from the cops under a bridge and resprays it at Pay n Spray.

longs.title: GTA 6 Fixing Up Jason's House - Full Gameplay
longs.description: A favour for the neighbor, a trip to the liquor store, then fixing the stairs, the railing, the leaky roof and the walls of Jason's house, and painting it green.

longs.title: GTA 6 Hunting Down Arnold - Full Mission
longs.description: Brian, Cal and Jason track Arnold to the radar station, Arnold tries to threaten Brian, and Jason chases him down the Keys.
